decisive_finding.cause: LifecyclePlan apply and RecoveryToken share one AtomicBool. apply consumes it before effects, so recovery after successful apply or after a failed automatic restore always returns ReplayedRecoveryToken before restore.

false_pass_control.missing_behavior: Tests recovered from a fabricated expected-after state without applying and covered recovery-then-apply, not apply-then-recover or failed-restore-then-recover.

corrective_action: Replace the shared boolean with an atomic lifecycle state machine that distinguishes planned, applying, recovery-available, recovering/consumed, and closed states. Arm recovery only from an authorized apply attempt, preserve it after failed automatic restore and successful apply where explicit recovery is promised, and reject pre-apply, concurrent, stale, substituted, and replayed recovery before effects.
claim_ceiling: The source candidate remains under REWORK. Package, marketplace, install, cache, app-registry, Plugins UI, discovery, runtime, lifecycle journey, readiness, release, and completion claims remain withheld.
no_claim_statement: This decision does not claim readiness, release, or completion.
